title: Unaired radio reveals Red Bull considered giving up Verstappen's Las Vegas lead
extract: Previously unheard team radio captures Red Bull discussing whether Verstappen should let Kimi Antonelli through before the final lap, revealing the team's late-race strategic dilemma.

title: Benchmarking the performance benefit of FRED on AMD Zen 6
extract: Phoronix tests Flexible Return and Event Delivery on dual-socket AMD EPYC 9006 Zen 6 hardware, finding up to a few percent gains in network and storage I/O workloads compared with disabling FRED.

title: Rovanpera: new 2027 WRC cars will see everybody start from zero
extract: The two-time champion expects the new Rally1 rules to reset the competitive order as he returns to Toyota for a partial WRC campaign after a year away.

title: Linus Torvalds: Tell your AI companion to get its act together
extract: A 41,000-line EXT4 pull request for Linux 7.4-rc5 includes extensive AI-generated changes and expanded KUnit coverage; Torvalds criticised the size and timing of the submission.

title: Pop!_OS 26.04 LTS released with more COSMIC apps and remote desktop
extract: System76's Ubuntu 26.04-based LTS release adds more COSMIC applications, automatic updates, remote desktop, drawing-tablet support and improved hybrid and multi-GPU handling.

title: AmigaOS 4: Video Vortex 2.0
extract: The AmigaOS 4 video client reaches version 2.0, giving classic Amiga systems a refreshed way to access modern YouTube content.

title: Datatype markdown.datatype 1.0
extract: A new datatype lets compatible Amiga applications handle Markdown documents through the operating system's standard datatype framework.

title: Holthinrichs celebrates 10 years with Signature Ornament Heritage Hand Engraved
extract: For its tenth anniversary, the Dutch independent pairs a 3D-printed Grade 5 titanium case with four hand-engraved German-silver dial variants, each limited to 25 pieces.

title: Patrick Stewart's final performance: Marvel colleagues call Xavier the conscience of Avengers
extract: Colleagues describe Stewart's final film-set day on Avengers: Doomsday, with Joe Russo calling Professor X the film's conscience; the role is Stewart's final screen performance.

title: QEMU: Amorphix
extract: The new Windows front end simplifies launching AmigaOS 4 and MorphOS virtual machines through QEMU on modern PCs.

title: Amiga Games That Weren't revisits the lost 1993 title Pancho Rossrooba
extract: The preservation feature revisits a previously unreleased 1993 Amiga game, documenting its recovery and later release for modern Amiga and PC players.

title: Race or Destroy for AGA Amigas
extract: The new arcade-style racing game targets AGA-equipped Amiga computers, adding another contemporary release for late-generation classic hardware.

title: CS-Lab Warp-Firmware-Pack 3.076
extract: The firmware bundle advances to version 3.076, bringing another update for CS-Lab Warp accelerator hardware used in Amiga systems.

title: Bremont adds its Perpetual Calendar GMT Monopusher to the Supernova
extract: The 20-piece Supernova adds a full perpetual calendar and a GMT display set via a crown monopusher, using an Agenhor-developed manual calibre with a 50-hour power reserve.

title: Hackers compromise Check Point servers in 22 organisations
extract: GreyNoise reports 24 compromised Check Point Security Management Servers across 22 organisations in 17 countries; the campaign targets management servers, not evidence that gateway firewalls were compromised.

title: Ubuntu outlines an AI-powered new way to interact with the desktop
extract: Canonical outlines an early Warty concept for interacting with the Ubuntu desktop through an AI assistant that can connect applications and tasks; it remains a development proposal.

title: THEA1200: deliveries are getting underway
extract: The modern A1200-compatible hardware project reports that delivery logistics are now moving, a tangible step from production toward customer fulfilment.

title: Collabora Online cuts per-document memory use by up to half
extract: A copy-on-write optimisation in Collabora Online can halve the server memory used per open document, improving density for self-hosted deployments.

title: The two-toned Hanhart 417 C Panna Flyback
extract: The 39mm steel-and-aluminium-bronze case pairs a warm panna dial with a hand-wound AMT5100 M column-wheel flyback movement and 58-hour reserve; production is limited to 100 pieces.

title: McDonald's Japan data breach exposes customer location information
extract: McDonald's Japan says an attacker accessed its app database, exposing purchase histories, IP addresses, device-location data and customer-management IDs, but not names, contact details or payment data.

title: TornadoVM 8.2 adds an AMD ROCm and HIP backend for Java GPU workloads
extract: TornadoVM 8.2 adds a dedicated AMD ROCm/HIP backend, extending Java GPU computing to AMD accelerators alongside its existing execution backends.

title: Linux 7.4 HID updates add new gamepad and laptop hardware support
extract: The Linux 7.4-rc5 HID pull adds support for the Speedlink Torid wireless controller, Logitech G915 Lightspeed receiver and ASUS laptop brightness keys, alongside driver fixes.

title: Audi-backed Slater to take over Camara's F2 seat for the final two rounds
extract: The Audi Driver Development Programme member will make his F2 debut with Invicta in Qatar and Abu Dhabi after finishing runner-up in F3, ahead of a planned full-time 2027 campaign.

title: zlib-rs 0.6.9 released with compression performance improvements
extract: The Rust zlib implementation's 0.6.9 release includes bug fixes and performance work, with its CRC32 path reporting up to 9.8 times faster processing on larger inputs and expanded PPC64LE testing.

title: SUSE Agama installer is gaining an AI-ready Model Context Protocol server
extract: Agama's new optional MCP server exposes installer and hardware context to AI clients, opening the door to assisted installation workflows.

title: Proton 11.0-3 expands the catalogue of Windows games playable on Linux
extract: Valve's latest Steam Play compatibility release adds more playable titles and updates across Wine, DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, controller handling and FEX.

title: Dave Grohl says Foo Fighters will go away for a while after touring
extract: Grohl says Foo Fighters plan to step back after the current touring cycle, suggesting a pause before their next chapter rather than an immediate follow-up album or tour.

title: First Children's Booker prize reveals its Great Eight shortlist
extract: The inaugural £50,000 prize names eight children's books for readers aged 8–12, spanning science fiction, time travel and comic fantasy adventures.

title: The Song of Stork and Dromedary by Anjet Daanje review
extract: Anjet Daanje's 720-page Yorkshire gothic follows a fictional literary icon through 11 lives and three centuries, using letters and testimony to explore how literary legends are made.

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth review: Tarantino and Fincher's team-up misses
extract: David Fincher directs Brad Pitt in Tarantino's follow-up to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood; the review finds the result an uneven, self-referential return to Cliff Booth.

title: TV this week: Blade Runner 2099, Cunk on Cinema, The Altruists and Snake Killer
extract: Le Monde finds Blade Runner 2099 visually striking but short on the films' melancholy, while Diane Morgan's Cunk on Cinema brings absurdist film-history comedy with unexpectedly sharp observations.

title: OpenRouter drops AI providers over leaked prompts and secrets
extract: After a security test found sensitive prompts and decoy credentials leaking through provider endpoints, OpenRouter removed three providers and revoked zero-data-retention status for 125 endpoints.

title: Why Stella believes Norris and Piastri had one of their best races in Las Vegas
extract: Norris and Piastri took second and third despite the MCL40's straight-line deficit; Piastri recovered from P17 after a grid penalty, prompting Stella's praise for their race management.
